HONEST_SCOREBOARD.role: Truth-table offered cents and span-valid captured cents; complete under par, not apparent fills.

GATE_1_OBJECT.role: P/Q/X require an author reading this leg; test 1 own receipt weights, test 2 own clock, test 3 no named pricing rule.

bench_taxonomy_receipt.role: Realized family rule, inherited 17-point taxonomy plus declared bench choices.
bench_taxonomy_receipt.signature_method: per leg, T-minus axis normalized to the verified span [formation end -> bell]: forward-filled last-true-print path sampled at 17 points (leading value = post-formation open); features net/travel/maxstep/bigstep_share/early(first-quarter) net/late(last-quarter) net/reversals; families by stated rules in family() (rule order: SLEEPER, ROUND_TRIP/QUIET_WOBBLE if |net|<5, LATE_BREAK if last quarter >=70% of net, EARLY_SET if first quarter >=70% and flat after, ONE_STEP if one inter-sample step >=60% of net, GRIND_WOBBLE if >=4 reversals and travel>=2|net|, else DRIFT)

bench_choices.causal_family_adaptation: At a receipt only, normalize formation through the current gate into 17 samples; do not use or forward-fill into the unknown remainder. Realized labels use formation through bell.
bench_choices.direction: early/late shares are signed relative to net; reversals omit zero steps
bench_choices.flat_after: abs(net after first quarter) <= 2 cents; operator-authorized bench choice, not taxonomy law
bench_choices.quiet_wobble_prose_caveat: The inherited travel split does not mathematically guarantee the prose 5-cent band. quiet_wobble_prose_band_exception is exposed; no new cutoff is introduced.
bench_choices.sleeper: actual post-formation true-print count < category empirical p10; bench choice, not taxonomy law
bench_choices.small_net_branch: abs(net)<5: ROUND_TRIP if travel>=10; otherwise QUIET_WOBBLE; no extra band filter

rules.missing: STORE SILENT; no number or author is invented.
rules.outcomes: Offered = positive truth discount; captured = positive discount of span-valid complete, otherwise zero; partial is zero.
rules.history: Fixed OS8_trace8 file appends a full snapshot to grades[]; earlier rubric results are retained.
rules.taxonomy: Read realized labels from the hash-bound bench. Compare each side's latest stored family as of bench bell minus gate*60 against that same bench gate; no OS timestamp or family is recomputed. MICRO and chart clocks stay unchanged.
rules.cascade_writers: FIELDS.md maps POOL_FIRST_TICK (alias), POOL_FIRST-TICK-ONLY, POOL_BASE, POOL_CASCADE:* and POOL_CASCADE_WRITER to ORGAN. Hold/veto precedence and raw tokens remain unchanged.
rules.ruler_comparison: Apply every event-matching correction from W1_GROUND_TRUTH_CORRECTIONS.jsonl @15955e44 in ledger order to the original pinned row. Effective floors, bell, span and denominator grade this run; original CSV and full correction JSONL rows remain alongside. Every observed fill is revalidated against both corrected span and bell. No trace, face input, or OS call is changed.
rules.micro: First eligible stored resolved P/Q/X forecast in receipt order versus full recorded span; every eligible receipt versus its remaining path, with separate carried state and strictly future-print targets. Match timing to each target using the original absolute deadline. Existing rubric cutoffs unchanged; worst of the two grading modes. Receipt-level errors, means and denominators retained.
rules.hands_ages: Separate original PLACE lineage age from current-price age, resetting only the latter on price change; remove/fill ends the lineage. Fill same-second check uses the current-price start timestamp. The legacy chart age is preserved, not used as current-price duration.
rules.named_scope: Exact symbolic named tokens on rows; no inference that unrecorded code branches are absent.
